title: Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic Speaking Test 4
description: Haqiqiy IELTS/CEFR Speaking formati: Rasmiy Cambridge IELTS 21 Test 4 bo‘yicha Part 1 (Kirish va kundalik mavzular), Part 2 (Cue Card taqdimot) va Part 3 (Tahliliy munozara).

sections.title: Speaking Assessment (Parts 1-3)
sections.instructions: Ushbu bo‘lim 3 ta qismdan iborat. Har bir qism topshirig‘i bilan tanishib chiqing, tayyor bo‘lgach mikrofon tugmasini bosib ovozingizni yozing va saqlang.

questions.question_text:
Part 1: Introduction & Everyday Topics (Speak for 1-2 minutes)

1. When do you usually eat bread?
2. How important is bread in your culture?
3. Have you tried any kinds of bread from other countries?
4. Would you be interested in learning how to make bread?

Part 2: Individual Long Turn / Cue Card (1 minute preparation, 2 minutes speaking)

Describe a person you know who is very competitive.
You should say:
• Who this person is
• What this person is competitive about
• How successful this person is
And explain why you think this person is so competitive.

Part 3: Two-way Discussion (Speak for 2-3 minutes)

1. What kinds of competitions do people like to enter in your country?
2. What do you think is the best kind of prize to win in a competition?
3. Why do people like watching quiz shows and other competitions on TV?
4. How important is it to be very competitive at sport?
5. Do you think sportspeople perform better when they play against competitors who are stronger than they are?
6. Why do some people think that taking part in sport is more important than winning?
